subject: POC Success Pledge — ops owners, timelines & next milestones
messages:
---Message 1/4---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@evergreentech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC Success Pledge — proposed criteria & owner asks

Sanjay — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery and a straightforward proposal for the POC so we can align owners and finish procurement. I put together a short "POC Success Pledge" (attached) so everyone can sign off on what success looks like and who will be responsible.

Key proposed success criteria (short):
- 95th percentile generation latency < 600 ms for 2k token requests under test load
- End-to-end API error rate < 0.5% over 24h soak
- Replicate 3 representative customer prompts with >= 0.85 BLEU/ROUGE-style quality baseline (see sheet)
- Integration end-to-end: app -> Redwood API -> verification step in staging environment

Immediate asks:
1) Confirm target POC start week (we proposed 2028-01-09)
2) Internal owners: who will own infra/network pieces on your side (VPC/VPN, firewall rules, egress)
3) Procurement contact and expected PO timeline

Proposed RACI (high level) — see attached for matrix, but to confirm now:
- Redwood (Account + SE): owner for model serving, rollout config, and observability (Marcus / Kimberly)
- Evergreen App Team: owner for app integration, test prompt corpus, acceptance tests (Sanjay)
- Evergreen Infra/Sec: owner for network/VPC peering and security sign-off (Aisha)
- Procurement: PO and SOW sign-off (tbd)

Next steps if this matches: we load the POC pledge (attached) into the shared Drive and schedule a 30-min kickoff next Thursday to lock owners and dates.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment stubs: poc-success-pledge-v1.xlsx (POC criteria + RACI matrix), evergreen-network-diagram.pdf (high-level network needs)

---Message 2/4---
From: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@evergreentech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aisha Reynolds <aisha.reynolds@evergreentech.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC Success Pledge — proposed criteria & owner asks

Marcus — really useful writeup, thanks. A few clarifications from our side:

- Start date: 2028-01-09 works for us but can do 2028-01-16 if procurement needs extra time (we'd prefer the earlier date)
- Latency target: our internal SLA is 500 ms for interactive features. Can we try a target of 500 ms P95? If not, call out tradeoffs (batching vs single-shot).
- Owners: I will be the app owner and will provide the test corpus. Aisha is the head of infra and sec — she will own VPN/VPC peering and security checklist. Procurement contact is me initially, but legal and procurement will loop in a formal PO approver.

We have an internal constraint: any external hosted service must pass a brief security checklist before we open ports. Aisha — can you confirm if you prefer a redwood-managed VPC peering or a private deployment with an air-gapped package?

Sanjay
Director, Product Engineering | Evergreen Tech

On Sat, Dec 4, 2027 at 09:03 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Marcus — really useful writeup, thanks.

---Message 3/4---
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@evergreentech.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC Success Pledge — proposed criteria & owner asks

Hi Sanjay / team — quick technical notes from the SE side to help set expectations:

- 500 ms P95 is aggressive for 2k tokens on some model families unless we tune sequence length or use a quantized variant. We can try to target 500 ms for the demo prompts (we suggest trimming to 1k where possible), otherwise we should scope a fallback SLA of 650 ms with an optimization plan to reach 500 ms by week 3.
- Network: VPC peering is fastest from an ops perspective; private on-prem would require more lead time and a security package (we can support either).
- Security checklist: happy to run through the questionnaire, but for a hosted approach we will provide SOC2 report, network diagram, and proof of encryption-at-rest; for private we'll provide deployment package and audit hooks.

I'll sketch a short RACI below (confirm or edit):
- Infra (Evergreen) — Aisha Reynolds (Responsible)
- App Integration (Evergreen) — Sanjay Mehta (Responsible)
- Redwood SE — Kimberly Park (Consulted / Responsible for deploy)
- Account Exec (Redwood) — Ben Carter (Account owner, Informed)
- Procurement (Evergreen) — TBD (Accountable for PO)

Proposed milestones:
- Dec 10: sign POC pledge and confirm procurement contact
- Dec 17: pre-kickoff checklist + network connectivity plan
- Jan 09: POC environment live (staging) and initial 24h soak
- Jan 16–Feb 06: validation window + metrics review

Would it help if we hosted a 30-min pre-kickoff next Wednesday to walk the network checklist and attach owners in the spreadsheet?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

---Message 4/4---
From: Aisha Reynolds <aisha.reynolds@evergreentech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Sanjay Mehta <sanjay@evergreentech.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC Success Pledge — proposed criteria & owner asks

Marcus / Kimberly — thanks. Quick decisions from infra/security side: we will do VPC peering for the POC (faster and acceptable from our compliance perspective). I can own the connectivity and firewall rule sign-off. Notes:

- I expect procurement to need a SOW and a 30-day billing window for the pilot; Sanjay will push the PO internally but we may need a short SOW addendum.
- On latency: we accept a two-step SLA: target 500 ms P95 for trimmed prompts and a secondary goal of 650 ms P95 for full 2k token samples. If Redwood can show optimization plan by week 3, we can consider that acceptable.
- I added two items to the spreadsheet (see attachment): a brief network diagram and the compliance checklist items we require for hosted services.

Next steps (agreed):
1) Marcus/Kimberly: update the POC pledge to reflect the two-step latency goal and add SOW note (due Dec 10)
2) Sanjay: confirm procurement approver and earliest PO date (due Dec 10)
3) Aisha: share firewall rule template and schedule a 30-min network sync (available Dec 15–16)
4) Ben: attach the SOW template / billing terms (Ben to provide by Dec 12)
5) Everyone: confirm whether we lock Jan 09 (preferred) or Jan 16 start (backup) by Dec 10

I'll reply with the official infra contact and a scan of the compliance checklist later today.

Thanks,
Aisha Reynolds
Head of Infrastructure & Security | Evergreen Tech
aisha.reynolds@evergreentech.com

Attachment stubs referenced: evergreen-network-diagram.pdf (updated), evergreen-compliance-checklist.xlsx
